listing.name: Final Fantasy Tactics Advance (FFTARecomp)
listing.summary: Upstream route: Windows/Linux/Steam Deck installer packages plus Android APK; owned-ROM compilation Limits: Work in progress with useful native player route; ROM-region documentation is inconsistent between installation and release notes. Upstream platforms: Windows x86-64 and Linux x86-64/SteamDeck setup archives; Android APK also observed, APK ABI unknown in frozen research. Original data: Own GBA ROM; v3 notes add Europe although installation section still says USA Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
